source.rule: The manual says PM tasks configured on composite top systems are ignored; only lowest-level subsystem PM is meaningful. This probe moves the accepted leaf-A CAL24 PM and PMLocation ID to the composite mother while preserving all structure, mission, timing, and failure-rate inputs.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Guarded session-0 SSH import/export must preserve all 21 populated authored tables; source, raw, GUI PID13340 and registry state are sealed and restored.

Observe whether installed converter rejects, warns, or accepts the composite-level PM. Do not treat a runner exit code alone as native rejection. Preserve exact converter diagnostics, SXO and report availability.

If calculation succeeds, reconcile event log PM task identities and timing, full 120-bin System/Stock ledgers, all three missions and terminal aircraft readiness against accepted leaf-PM parent. If native PM still occurs at h24/49, classify the installed outcome as a bounded counterexample to literal ignored-top-PM wording, not as evidence of ignored PM.
Require independent read-only replay and a restricted sign-off before any publication.
limits: One composite top with two zero-failure child systems and one moved CAL24 PM only. Wrong-level corrective repair, other PM options, failure propagation, GUI visual and cross-engine behavior remain unverified.
